name: Grilled Tomato-Garlic Chicken Thighs with Bell Pepper & Cabbage Salad
instructions: Mince anchovy fillets. Place in a medium bowl along with tomato paste, oil, and spices. Stir to combine the marinade.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the marinade. Using your hands, massage the marinade into the chicken.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Add the chicken and grill until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry bell peppers. Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice the peppers. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Add shredded cabbage, pumpkin seeds, and dressing to the bowl with the bell pepper. Stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken and cabbage salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
